title: 機械加工学
subtitle: Machining Engineering
educationalGoal: (1) Learn the basic theory of removal machining. (2) Learn methods to measure cutting force and cutting edge temperature. (3) Learn the types of tool damage and their causes. (4) Learn how to manufacture cutting tools using powder metallurgy and surface coating techniques. (5) Learn how to select cutting tool materials and cutting conditions.
advice: This class will cover the following topics: 1. Classification of processing methods 2. Chip formation mechanism (Classification and formation mechanism of chips, Built-up edge, Generation conditions, and Methods to prevent built-up edge) 3. Cutting theory (Theoretical calculation of cutting force and Theoretical calculation of cutting temperature) 4. Measurement of cutting specifications (Cutting force, Cutting temperature, Chip thickness, and Contact length between chip and rake face) 5. Cutting tool wear and wear factors 6. Cutting tool material (Type and Classification) 7. Powder metallurgy technology and coating technology 8. Finished surface quality and control 9. Machinability of difficult-to-cut materials Students should be aware of the teacher’s instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses.
books: Textbooks:[Practical Cutting Method (2nd Edition) ],Yoshio Fujimura, Kyouritsu syuppan Reference books:[Introduction of Machining],Takekazu Sawa, Nikkann Kougyou Shinbun (in Japanese) Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to watch the machining videos that supplement the lecture content. In addition, it is important to have the experiences of touring machining facilities and attending a machine industry fair.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the basics of cutting theory.
Be able to understand the measurement methods for cutting specifications.
Be able to understand the form and factors of tool damage.
Be able to understand the types of cutting tool materials and their effective use.
Be able to understand the types of difficult-to-cut materials and their machinability.
Be able to select optimum cutting conditions and machine tools.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) A two-dimensional cutting model and the theoretical mechanism of shearing can be explained using figures. (2) Measurement methods of cutting force and cutting temperature can be explained using detailed figures. (3) The damage classification of cutting tools and its cause can be explained in detail. (4) The method for manufacturing cutting tools with powder metallurgy and surface coating techniques can be explained in detail. (5) The finished surface quality can be explained. (6) The machining conditions, and tool shape for high-efficiency machining can be selected appropriately.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) A two-dimensional cutting model and the theoretical mechanism of shear can be explained. (2) Measuring methods for cutting force and cutting temperature can be explained. (3) The types and causes of cutting tool damage can be explained. (4) Methods for using powder metallurgy and surface coating technology can be described. (5) Surface roughness can be explained. (6) The machining method, machining conditions, and tool shape can be selected.

lessons.content: Course introduction Basics of metal cutting and classification of processing methods
lessons.assignments: Understand the course objectives. Study pp.1-4 of textbook

lessons.content: Concept of cutting mechanism based on orthogonal cutting model. Review test on the fundamentals of metal cutting
lessons.assignments: Study pp.5-10 of textbook Review about orthogonal cutting model

lessons.content: Classification of chip morphology and ideal chips morphology. Generation mechanism of built-up edge.
lessons.assignments: Study pp.9-12 of textbook Review about classification of chip morphology

lessons.content: Conditions that generate a built-up edge and methods to prevent it. Basics of cutting force.
lessons.assignments: Study pp.10-14 of textbook Review conditions that generate a built-up edge and methods to prevent it.

lessons.content: Concept and theoretical calculation of cutting force
lessons.assignments: Study pp.14-18 of textbook Review about derivation of theoretical formula for cutting force.

lessons.content: Experimental techniques and methods of measuring phenomena during cutting.
lessons.assignments: Study pp.32-39 and pp.50-60 of textbook Review about the measuring method of cutting force and temperature.

lessons.content: Exercises on theoretical calculation based on measured data during cutting force.
lessons.assignments: understand about theoretical formula for cutting force. Review about the calculation method for cutting force.

lessons.content: Tool wear patterns and wear mechanisms.
lessons.assignments: Study pp.61-78 of textbook Review the Tool wear patterns and cutting environment.
Study pp.68-78 of textbook. (Especially about the cause of Tool wear) Review the tool wear patterns and the cause of tool wear.

lessons.content: Material properties required for tool materials. Characteristics of tool materials and their application (high-speed steel, cemented carbide, and coated cemented carbide)
lessons.assignments: Study pp.101-109 of textbook. Review the material properties required for tool and characteristics of tool materials.

lessons.content: Characteristics of tool materials and their application (cermet, ceramics, cubic boron nitrite, and poly-crystalline diamond)
lessons.assignments: Study pp.108-130 of textbook Review the material properties required for tool and characteristics of tool materials.

lessons.content: Definition and classification of hard to cut materials.
lessons.assignments: Study pp.190-195 of textbook Review the classification of hard to cut materials and machining problems.

lessons.content: Learn the characteristics of hard to cut materials and cutting conditions.
lessons.assignments: Study about characteristics of hard to cut materials. Review the machining problems and countermeasures it.

lessons.content: Explanation of Quiz 4 Review of classes 1 to 13. Final exam.
lessons.assignments: Review of classes 1 to 13. self-inspection of final exam.

lessons.content: Explanation of final exam. Various machining method.
